item.title: Diamond in the Rough! C. 1884. Over three acres in North Carolina. $345,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! It has nice potential and a pretty setting! This house would really benefit from a floor plan being included with the listing. The house was built in 1884. It is located on 3.11 acres in Fairview, North Carolina. The house features a wrap around front porch, a large stone chimney, wide baseboards, crown moulding, wainscoting and bead board. There is a detached garage on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,425 square feet. $345,000

item.title: Loads of potential! Great town! Over one acre in Virginia. $145,000
item.description: This is a great little town! The house has loads of potential and looks livable. The house was built in 1880. It is located on 1.33 acres in Chatham, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, wide baseboards, bay windows and a claw foot tub. That kitchen could definitely use some work. item.title: 5,000 sf! Former rectory. Beautiful woodwork! C. 1880 in Wisconsin. $225,000
item.description: This is a huge house with almost 5,000 square feet! This was the former St. Paul’s Cathedral Rectory. It was built in 1880. It is located on .56 acre in Fond Du Lac, Wisconsin. The house features a limestone exterior, pretty staircase, baseboards, crown moulding, coffered ceiling, french doors, beautiful fireplaces, and some wood floors. I bet all of the wood floors are still underneath the carpeting. Six bedrooms, six bathrooms and 4,951 square feet. $225,000 Contact Teresa Keenan with Klapperi

The property includes the 1790 main house, three guest houses, pool, pool house and a lodge. There are three lakes on the property. item.title: Alaska time! 105 acres! Private airstrip and lake. $400,000
item.description: Alaska time! Really nice acreage with this one. Even has a private airstrip. The house was built in 1951. It is located on 105 acres in Homer, Alaska. The house didn’t look as bad inside as I expected. The listing says that indoor plumbing is being installed. A lot of history with this property. The farm at Bear Cove was originally settled by Harold and Roxie Pomeroy. They grew cabbage and potatoes. Roxie would take her produce into town via dinghy to sell. item.description: This listing includes two houses and a bit of acreage in Florida. There is a lot of potential! The house was built in 1951. It is located on 3.32 acres in Monticello, Florida. The house features a screened in front porch, wood floors, spacious kitchen and built-in bookshelves. The second house on the property needs a bit more work, but they both have potential!
